Todo mês, a Politon Data mostra quanto a União pagou a cada Poder no último mês com dados já publicados. Este é setembro de 2026.

Pagamentos nos Orçamentos Fiscal e da Seguridade Social (OFSS) da União em setembro/2026: cerca de R$ 526,7 bi (R$ 526.658.813.945,83) · −19,6% vs. agosto (R$ 655,1 bi).
• Executivo: cerca de R$ 518,7 bi (R$ 518.662.008.451,06) · −19,9% vs. agosto
• Judiciário: cerca de R$ 5,7 bi (R$ 5.724.874.992,35) · +8,8% vs. agosto
• Legislativo, incluindo TCU: cerca de R$ 1,4 bi (R$ 1.359.269.667,83) · −1,0% vs. agosto
• Ministério Público da União e CNMP: cerca de R$ 846,4 mi (R$ 846.359.967,44) · +29,1% vs. agosto
• Defensoria Pública da União: cerca de R$ 66,3 mi (R$ 66.300.867,15) · +62,3% vs. agosto

Acumulado de janeiro a setembro de 2026 (9 meses publicados): cerca de R$ 4,8 tri (R$ 4.761.964.664.973,09).

Por brasileiro: R$ 2.467,70 em setembro = R$ 526,7 bi ÷ 213.421.037 habitantes, o equivalente a 1,5 salários mínimos de 2026 (R$ 1.621,00). Conta da Politon Data; o total inclui dívida e despesas financeiras.
População: IBGE, Estimativas da População 2025 (Portaria IBGE nº 1.098/2025, DOU 28/08/2025), ref. 1º/7/2025 — https://t.co/svt5nRWbnL
Salário mínimo: Decreto nº 12.797/2025 (DOU 24/12/2025) — https://t.co/LjuuCtv20Q

Siglas: OFSS = Orçamentos Fiscal e da Seguridade Social · TCU = Tribunal de Contas da União · MPU = Ministério Público da União · CNMP = Conselho Nacional do Ministério Público · DPU = Defensoria Pública da União · Siafi = Sistema Integrado de Administração Financeira · RREO = Relatório Resumido da Execução Orçamentária.

Ressalvas:
Inclui restos a pagar, despesas financeiras e dívida. Exclui Extra-Siafi e o Orçamento de Investimento das estatais.
Dados publicados e revisáveis. Não representam fechamento definitivo nem todo o custeio público.
A competência de setembro de 2026 está fora do intervalo de controle RREO disponível, de janeiro de 2026 a agosto de 2026.

#Watch | Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw inspected the manufacturing of India's first indigenously developed high-speed bullet train, B28, at BEML's Aditya manufacturing facility in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The trainsets are being developed for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor, with a design speed of 280 kmph and an operational speed of 249 kmph.

The project involves the development of two eight-coach trainsets by BEML. The first prototype is expected to be ready in the first quarter of 2027, following which it will undergo extensive testing and trials. The development marks a significant step towards strengthening India's indigenous high-speed rail manufacturing capabilities.

Q2 FY27: Concalls with Strong Growth Guidance

HFCL
Revenue growth guidance for FY27 has been raised from 20% to 40%, and now to over 80%. The order book stands at ₹28,900 Cr, and management sees ₹10,000 Cr revenue possibly before FY29.

Sterlite Tech
The order book has grown from ₹7,700 Cr in April to ₹35,000 Cr. Management has reiterated its target of ₹20,000 Cr revenue by FY29.

Netweb
Revenue grew 336%, with AI servers up about 10x. The company is aiming for ₹4,000 Cr revenue this year, with an ₹11,000 Cr pipeline.

MTAR
Revenue tripled this quarter, and full-year growth guidance is 80%. Order wins in H1 were ₹4,100 Cr.

Unimech Aerospace
Revenue nearly doubled and the order book is up about 8x. Over 340 parts are still in qualification, with a larger ramp-up expected from FY28.

Apollo Micro
Guiding for 35–45% growth. The order book is at a record level and is expected to cross ₹2,000 Cr by March. Planned expansion takes capacity to almost 12x current levels.

Sri Lotus
Revenue and profit growth guided at 55–60% for the year. H1 pre-sales grew 176%.

Aarti Pharmalabs
Profit rose from ₹24 Cr to ₹66 Cr. Growth guidance for this year is 40–50%, with peptides expected to contribute from FY28.

Acutaas
The ₹1,000 Cr CDMO revenue target has been reached a year ahead of plan. The next target is ₹2,000 Cr by FY30, with margins near 40%.

SG Mart
Management has guided for 50%+ annual earnings growth over the next 3–4 years.

Sakar Healthcare
Profit grew 149%. Oncology revenue is expected at about ₹200 Cr this year and ₹300 Cr next year, becoming roughly half the business.

Kissht (Onemi)
Profit doubled, and loan growth guidance has been raised to over 60%.
